About

Caitlin Clift is a New York City-based political science and public policy alum from the University of California, Berkeley. She holds a specialization in cinematography from the Universidad Carlos III de Madrid, a certification in international affairs from the University of Southern California, and a certification in journalism from the School of the New York Times.

She has worked as an audio engineer for KALX and KPFA and has bylines in the San Francisco Chronicle, Bay Area Current, Outside Lands, and the UC Berkeley Comparative Literature Undergraduate Journal.

She currently works as a freelance reporter while pursuing a master's degree in journalism.
